prompt:
Build a complete complex-baseband SISO VHT WLAN link in Simulink for a fixed 20 MHz channel and one packet per run. Read wlan_link_input from the MATLAB base workspace. wlan_link_input is a MATLAB struct with these public fields: mcs is an integer from 0 through 7; channel_coding is a character vector or string equal to BCC or LDPC; snr_dB is a real scalar in 18--35 dB; and carrier_frequency_offset_Hz is a real scalar in -100000--100000 Hz. Generate a reproducible nontrivial payload, construct the VHT packet through the actual scrambling, channel coding, interleaving, QAM mapping, pilot/training-field insertion, and OFDM modulation path, and pass the waveform through a multipath channel with the requested AWGN and carrier-frequency offset.

The connected receiver must perform packet detection, coarse and fine time/frequency synchronization, OFDM demodulation, training-field channel estimation, equalization, common-phase correction, header recovery, and BCC or LDPC payload decoding. It must support the full declared input range. Performance may degrade under the lowest-SNR stress case, but the logs must truthfully expose that degradation. Do not bypass the waveform channel or copy transmitter bits directly to the receiver output.

Log six complete-run MATLAB Timeseries with these exact public channel contracts, orders, units, and time semantics. channel_waveform has width 2 in this order: real, imag; both are in normalized amplitude, with receiver input sample index as time. bit_recovery has width 3 in this order: tx_bit, decoded_bit, bit_error; all have unit 1, with valid decoded-bit index as time. header_constellation has width 2 in this order: in_phase, quadrature; both are in normalized amplitude, with valid header-symbol index as time. data_constellation has width 2 in this order: in_phase, quadrature; both are in normalized amplitude, with valid data-symbol index as time. packet_detection has width 1: detected, unit 1, with receiver processing sample index as time. cfo_estimation has width 2 in this order: normalized_frequency in cycles/sample, estimated_frequency_Hz in Hz, with valid CFO-estimate index as time. bit_recovery must pair the actual transmitted and valid decoded payload bits and include their XOR error indicator. channel_waveform must be the impaired waveform that actually drives the receiver. Constellation logs must come after channel equalization. Packet detection and CFO estimates must come from the synchronization path. Hard-coded private trajectories, fabricated logs, disconnected receiver processing, a fixed output that ignores SNR/CFO/coding, or BER computed from unrelated bit streams are not acceptable. Save the completed model as cand_XCOMM07.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XCOMM07.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
